Path collection v2 · default: overall pairwise consensus.

Golf 2.1 identifies the classifications; path v2 identifies the ordering. The default combines RF and ZL equally, both penalties equally, and the best eligible fit per sample across all sections. The selector includes three conditional endings and the original proposed path. Consensus scores do not establish historical probabilities or direct connections.

What the percentage measures

It is the share of all page variation that remains within a bifolium. Lower values mean closer agreement between its pages.

The remaining variation lies between bifolia. Each page receives equal weight.

How to read the path

V2 scores summarize same-run ordering comparisons, with ties receiving half weight. Lower is earlier. They are not probabilities, dates or elapsed time. Page and pooled-bifolium scores have different peer populations.

V2 lines are display guides through the existing eight-axis ZL maps at fixed consensus scores. They do not change the scores and are not an individual ElPiGraph fit. The legacy selector restores the original full-space curve and projections.

All v2 paths retain the existing 1a-before-1b eligibility condition. Conditional endings filter fits before selecting the best per sample; available sample counts vary. Full method and named paths.
